description: This file implements utilities for nl80211 attributes, including initialization, cleanup, and management of nested attributes in a wireless networking context.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_initNlAttrList
methods.description: Initializes a list of nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanNlAttr
methods.description: Cleans up a nl80211 attribute, including nested attributes if present.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanNlAttrList
methods.description: Cleans up a list of nl80211 attributes, removing each and reinitializing the list.
